sources.title: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-GGUF: Quantized Open-Source LLM for Local ...
sources.snippet: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-GGUF Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-GGUF is a 7.6 billion parameter instruction-tuned language model from Alibaba's Qwen team, quantized in GGUF format for efficient local deployment. It supports 32K token context (8K generation), handles 29+ languages, and is optimized for coding, math, and structured data tasks.
